report: The Future of Digital Spaces and Their Role in Democracy
publisher: Pew Research Center and Elon University's Imagining the Internet Center

entries.label: Digital spaces serve the public good by 2035
entries.quote: Looking ahead to 2035, will digital spaces and people's use of them be changed in ways that significantly serve the public good?
entries.subject: digital public sphere
entries.note: The report says many 'yes' answers added that the outcome could go either way.

notes: One closed question from a non-random opt-in canvassing, followed by open-ended elaboration (not captured). Pew calls the results nonscientific and not projectable.
